violation_type.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.701(1))
violation_type.short_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found that the YMCA program did not complete an incident report.

finding_variants.text: It was found that the YMCA program did not complete an incident report.
It was determined that the Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form was not completed for an injury that required medical attention.

The operation's ouch report did not provide the parent a complete report that contained all of the required information on the incident/illness form, 7239.  Form 7239 was provided to the parent, and signature obtained 14 days after the accident occurred.
This standard was part of an investigation.     The operation did not use the state licensing incident/illness report.  The one the operation used was lacking the required information.

It was determined that the Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form was not completed for an injury that required medical attention.  Information is needed as to how the program will complete and provide an incident report to parents in a timely manner.
The licensing report form was not completed for an injury required medical treatment.
